Guides / Battle & team / Roles & passives

Roles & passives

DPS, Break and Support, how rarity scales them, and every passive.

Break and bossesSupportTeam bonusPassives

Every species has one fixed role. The lead fights; the bench does its role every few turns.

RoleWhat it does
DPS+15% Attack and Sp. Atk. Best as your lead.
BreakFrom the bench, every 2 turns it lowers the foe's Defense and Sp. Def, makes balls more likely to work, and smashes boss shields.
SupportFrom the bench, every 3 turns it heals your lead.

Rarer Pokémon do their role harder: Common ×1, Uncommon ×1.25, Rare ×1.6, Legendary ×2.2, and each Power-up adds 5%.

Break and bosses

From the bench, every 2 turns Break Pokémon crack a boss's shield for 16 × their role strength (the lead chips it too: 14 a hit for a Break lead, 5 for anyone else). Against wild Pokémon they lower its Defense and Sp. Def and raise your catch chance instead. See Bosses.

Support

From the bench, every 3 turns Supports heal your lead by 8% of its max HP × their role strength.

Team bonus

  • Balanced: a DPS lead with a Break and a Support behind it: +10% all stats.
  • Prism Aura: a Prismatic in the party: +10% all stats for everyone.
  • Lucky: each Shiny in the party +15% money from battles (up to 3).

Passives

PassiveEffect
Rarity powerUncommon +5%, Rare +15%, Legendary +35% all stats.
AlphaA boss that joined you: bigger, +20% all stats.
Shiny bonus+10% all stats, +15% battle money while in the party (up to 3 shinies).
Shadow Veil (Void)Halves the first hit it takes in every fight.
Prism Aura (Prismatic)The whole party gets +10% all stats while it's with you.
Flawless (Perfect IVs)+10% all stats on top.
Powered up+3% all stats and 5% stronger at its role per Power level (max +10).
